data.notes: Page describes the Dream Together Masters Program at SNU (Seoul National University), while the name given is The Dream Scholarship; the page title says Dream Together Scholarship. Preferred qualifications (sport administrators or athletes from ODA recipient countries, with endorsement) are preferences, not requirements. GPA is assessed but no minimum is stated. No application deadline or funding amount is stated; benefits are only linked, not described. Nationality rule is inferred from the non-Korean nationality requirement for the applicant and both parents.
